title: The Real Problem
text: What happens when a company receives a supplier invoice that doesn't match what was ordered? In accounts payable, invoices, purchase orders, and receiving logs constantly arrive with discrepancies: price overcharges, quantity shortages, or tax variances. Traditional ERP systems easily flag the math mismatch. But detecting an exception is only half the battle. The hardest part is deciding what to do next: Has this supplier billed this way before? Did an authorized manager negotiate a waiver? And is that previous approval still valid under current company procurement policy?

title: Our Insight & Innovation
text: That's why we built LedgerMind. An invoice exception isn't just a math error—it's an operational decision requiring context, precedent, and accountability. LedgerMind combines deterministic three-way matching with persistent institutional memory powered by Hindsight, version-governed policy evaluation, and fast Groq inference. Our central innovation: LedgerMind never blindly follows history. It cross-examines remembered precedents against the company's governing procurement rules. When past habit conflicts with policy, policy constraints govern, and the reviewer is alerted. This policy-versus-precedent intelligence is LedgerMind's core breakthrough.

title: New Invoice Intake & 3-Way Match
text: Here in the live application, the Overview tracks six discrepancy categories across twenty benchmark scenarios. Both our local Hindsight vector engine and SQLite operational database are online and healthy. Through New Invoice Intake, teams can create or import new invoices. Here we submit an invoice for Nova Tech Supplies: invoice INV-NOVA-2025-002. The purchase order specified one thousand rupees, but the vendor billed eleven hundred across ten units. With eighteen percent GST, LedgerMind instantly calculates a discrepancy of eleven hundred and eighty rupees, and syncs it immediately to SQLite and the active Invoice Queue.

title: Resolution Workbench & Human Review
text: In the Resolution Workbench, LedgerMind evaluates the discrepancy. With memory enabled, the agent checks governing policy POL-AP-002 and identifies that price variances exceeding contract rates require line-item adjustment. LedgerMind generates an EDITED proposal, resetting unit rates to the contract price. Crucially, the human reviewer retains full authority. We submit our review as an authorized AP Specialist. The decision, adjusted amount, and audit rationale are permanently saved to both SQLite and persistent Hindsight memory.

title: Hindsight Memory & Live Provenance
text: Look closely at our Hindsight vector memory integration. For invoice INV-PI-2025-101 from Prabhav Infosystems, Hindsight performs live semantic recall. Notice the storage badge: every card displays 'Hindsight Vector DB' with verified live provenance. Our multi-pass evidence deduplication consolidates sub-facts from a single Zenith review into one card, preserving slots for direct Prabhav precedents. Cross-vendor precedents are clearly flagged with orange badges, while the invoice's own historical review is excluded from confidence scoring. In our Memory Comparison view, Memory OFF yields zero context, while Memory ON boosts confidence to seventy-five percent, grounded in three consistent prior decisions.

title: Why LedgerMind is Different
text: Most enterprise tools stop at finding where the numbers don't add up. LedgerMind's value is in helping a human reviewer understand what the organization learned before, whether that precedent is still valid, and why a specific resolution is justified right now. It unites historical recall, policy conflict detection, explainable evidence, and human accountability into a coherent decision workflow.

title: Technical Lessons & The Road Ahead
text: Building LedgerMind taught us a key architectural lesson: never interleave blocking health probes into asynchronous vector queries, and keep supplier tag taxonomies strictly isolated from corporate legal stopwords. Today, LedgerMind is a working prototype with manual and CSV intake. In the future, we envision native ERP connectors, automated OCR, and enterprise role-based access. LedgerMind helps finance teams move from detecting invoice exceptions to making consistent, policy-backed decisions. Thank you.
